title: New York Law Journal features Greg McPolin and Charles Griffin on litigation strategy in a capital-constrained healthcare market
summary: Writing in New York Law Journal, Greg McPolin and Charles Griffin examine how healthcare organizations are approaching litigation strategy in a challenging financial environment. The article explores how legal finance can help providers pursue affirmative recoveries while preserving capital and maintaining focus on core operations. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Writing in *New York Law Journal* ,[Greg McPolin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/greg-mcpolin/) and[Charles Griffin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/charles-griffin/) examine how healthcare organizations are approaching litigation strategy in a challenging financial environment. The article explores how legal finance can help providers pursue affirmative recoveries while preserving capital and maintaining focus on core operations.


Read the full article[here](https://www.law.com/newyorklawjournal/2026/05/26/rethinking-litigation-strategy-in-a-capital-constrained-healthcare-market/) .
